    u = Object.values(I?.cities ?? {}), f = I?.map?.placements ?? [], m = I?.chapterOrder ?? [], l = !0, d = "已讀取遊戲據點資料。";
  }
  async function v() {
    if (!s || !h()) return;
    const y = {};
    return t(async () => {
      try {
        await g(y);
      } catch (R) {
        d = R.message ?? String(R);
      }
      p();
    });
  }
  async function S(y, R, I) {

          d = k.message ?? String(k);
        }
        p();
      });
  }
  const C = {
    enter: () => {
      if (!(i || !s))
        return i = !0, v();
    },
    refresh: v,
    createCity: (y) => {
      const R = {};
      for (const k of ["max_prod", "prod", "growth", "defence", "troops", "type", "view"]) {
        const O = Number(y?.numbers?.[k]);
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(O) || O < 0 || O > 65535) throw new Error(`數值欄 ${k} 須為 0..65535 整數`);
        R[k] = O;
      }
      const I = String(y?.name ?? "").trim();
      if (!I) throw new Error("據點名稱必填");
      return S("cities", { create: { name: I, numbers: R } }, "建檔完成。下一步：在地圖選位並放置圖塊。");
    },
    bindCity: (y) => {
      if (!y?.pieceId || !y?.cityId) throw new Error("圖塊與據點檔案必選");
      return S("map", { edits: [{ op: "city-bind", pieceId: y.pieceId, cityId: y.cityId }] }, "綁定完成。下一步：接見 admit 全章。");
    },
    admitCity: (y) => {
      if (!y?.cityId) throw new Error("據點檔案必選");
      const R = Number(y?.troops_cap);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(R) || R < 0 || R > 255) throw new Error("城兵上限須為 0..255 整數");
      if (!/^ki-1995:siege:(\d{1,3})$/.test(y?.battleMapId ?? "") || Number(y.battleMapId.slice(15)) > 191) throw new Error("攻城戰場須為 ki-1995:siege:0..191");
      return S("chapters", { admit: { cityId: y.cityId, troops_cap: R, battleMapId: y.battleMapId } }, "全章接見完成。下一步：鋪走廊並加路。");
    },
    addRoad: (y) => {
      if (!y?.fromCityId || !y?.toCityId || y.fromCityId === y.toCityId) throw new Error("起訖據點必選且須不同");
      if (y?.travelKind !== "land" && y?.travelKind !== "water") throw new Error("行旅種類須為 land／water");
      const R = String(y?.geometry ?? "").split(";").map((I) => I.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((I) => {
        const k = /^(\d{1,3}),(\d{1,3})$/.exec(I);
        if (!k) throw new Error(`路徑格格式須為 x,y，以分號分隔：${I}`);
        return { x: Number(k[1]), y: Number(k[2]) };
      });
      if (R.length < 2) throw new Error("路徑至少兩格");
      return S("map", { edits: [{
        op: "road-add",
        roadId: `${s}#road-` + [...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32))].map((I) => I.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(""),
        fromCityId: y.fromCityId,
        toCityId: y.toCityId,
        travelKind: y.travelKind,
        geometry: R
      }] }, "道路寫入完成。請檢驗後發布。");
    }
  };
  function w(y) {
    y !== s && (s = y, i = !1, l = !1, u = [], f = [], m = [], d = y ? "" : "請先在頂部選擇自己的遊戲。", c = !h() || !y, p());
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    actions: Object.freeze(C),
    adoptGame: w,
    selectedGame: () => h() ? s : null,
    canAdoptGame: () => h(),
    canLeave: () => !0,
    dirty: () => !1,
    render: p,
    setIdentity(y) {
      o === y && r === (y?.version ?? null) || (o = y, r = y?.version ?? null, w(h() && a ? a.current() : null), c = !h() || !s, p());
    },
    dispose() {
      s = null, i = !1;
    }
  });
}
